title: SecretScanExceptionsPolicy
description: Owner-approved, time-bounded false-positive exceptions for release-time secret scanning.

allowedOwners.description: Handles permitted to approve exceptions. Changes require CODEOWNERS review.

maxExpiryDays.description: Maximum exception duration measured from approvedAt.

exceptions.description: Active verified false-positive exceptions. Never store plaintext secrets here.

id.description: Unique exception identifier, for example EXC-2026-001.

ruleId.description: Secret scanner rule id, or '*' for all rules.

path.description: Repository-relative path or glob pattern; absolute paths and '..' are forbidden.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the detected value, or '*' to match any value at the path.

approvedAt.description: Approval date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format; cannot be in the future.

expiresAt.description: Expiration date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format; expired exceptions fail the scan.

justification.description: Evidence that the match is a verified false positive.
